newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Office Depot downgraded.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Office Depot downgraded.

text.p: -- Interstate/Johnson Lane said in a research note that it lowered its recommendation on Office Depot to neutral from buy since the shares are "fairly valued" under terms of the acquisition by Staples Inc.
-- Based on Wednesday's closing Staples share price of $18.50, Office Depot shares are worth $21 in the deal.
-- "We think the deal has a high probability of closing in the three-four month time frame which has been estimated," according to the analyst report.

-- Interstate/Johnson Lane said it expects the merged company to earn $0.90 per share next year "which represents about a 10 percent increase from what Staples was expected to earn on its own in 1997."
-- Staples shares rose 1/4 to 19 in midday Nasdaq trade, while Office Depot added 3/8 to 20-3/4 in the New York Stock Exchange.
